title: Zero Day Mod
description: A magic-focused mod that adds magical staffs, Arcane armor, unique items, and new ways to experience Minecraft through the power of sorcery.
body:
# Zero Day Mod

Zero Day Mod is a magic-themed mod focused on expanding Minecraft with magical equipment, mystical items, and fantasy-inspired content while keeping the gameplay simple and survival-friendly.

The mod currently adds several magical staffs, including the Arcane Staff, Frost Staff, Wind Staff, and Ender Staff. Each one is designed to provide a different magical experience and give players new options during exploration and combat.

Players can also craft and wear the full Arcane Armor set, consisting of a helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots. The armor is designed to fit the magical theme of the mod and provide a unique progression path for players interested in magic.

In addition to equipment, the mod introduces special items such as Arcane Coin and Magma Shock, along with a custom wizard-themed entity that helps bring more life to the magical world of Zero Day Mod.

## Features

- Four magical staffs
- Full Arcane Armor set
- Custom magical items
- Wizard-themed entity
- Survival-friendly crafting recipes
- Fantasy-inspired progression

This mod is intended for players who want a lightweight magic experience without completely changing the core feel of Minecraft.

More content and magical features are planned for future updates.
